subtopics.mastery: Mastery: perform or solve an unfamiliar sounds and pronunciation task independently, explain the reasoning or technique, correct a plausible error, and verify the final result against the stated criteria.

Students should explain their choices, identify errors or misconceptions, and verify the result rather than relying on memorisation alone.
subtopics.worked_example: Worked example: complete a representative role play task, identify the key rule, clue, language feature or performance criterion, then explain and verify the result.
subtopics.pitfall: Common pitfall: confusing a related term, form, interpretation or technique with the exact requirement of the task, or skipping verification after producing an answer or performance sample.
subtopics.mastery: Mastery: perform or solve an unfamiliar role play task independently, explain the reasoning or technique, correct a plausible error, and verify the final result against the stated criteria.

subtopics.title: conversation strategy
subtopics.teaching: Choose language appropriate to the listener, situation, purpose, and level of formality before responding.
subtopics.worked_example: A request to a teacher should use a respectful form, while the same information can be phrased more casually with a close friend.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: using the same tone and expression for every listener.
subtopics.mastery: Select and deliver an appropriate Hindi response for a given social context.

subtopics.title: meaning from spoken context
subtopics.teaching: Use key words, tone, grammar, and surrounding dialogue to infer what a Hindi speaker intends when not every word is familiar.
subtopics.worked_example: If a speaker gives a time, place, and action together, use those clues to infer the requested plan even when one vocabulary item is unknown.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: stopping comprehension completely because of one unfamiliar word.
subtopics.mastery: Infer the main meaning and speaker intention from contextual Hindi clues.

subtopics.title: pronunciation and repair
subtopics.teaching: Identify unclear sounds, syllable stress, vowel length, and word endings, then repair them through slow repetition and controlled re-speaking.
subtopics.worked_example: When a listener repeatedly mishears a word, isolate the difficult sound, say the word slowly, then place it back into the full sentence.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: repeating the same unclear pronunciation faster instead of changing the practice method.
subtopics.mastery: Detect a pronunciation issue and improve intelligibility through targeted practice.

subtopics.title: integrated speaking scenarios
subtopics.teaching: Combine listening, vocabulary, grammar, turn-taking, clarification, and polite speech in realistic Hindi conversations.
subtopics.worked_example: A travel dialogue can require understanding a question, giving directions, asking for clarification, and confirming the destination.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: memorizing isolated sentences without adapting them to the actual conversation.
subtopics.mastery: Sustain a context-appropriate Hindi exchange while responding to changing conversational cues.

subtopics.title: Hindi speaking championship round
subtopics.teaching: Practice timed speaking challenges with clear pronunciation, relevant responses, controlled pace, active listening, and confident recovery from mistakes.
subtopics.worked_example: In a timed role-play, listen fully, answer directly, ask one useful clarification when necessary, and continue without abandoning the conversation after a minor error.
subtopics.pitfall: Pitfall: focusing so heavily on perfect grammar that the response becomes delayed or disconnected.
subtopics.mastery: Complete a timed Hindi speaking task with understandable pronunciation, relevant content, and confident conversational control.
